            <div class="postBody">

<p>openEuler欧拉操作系统</p>
<h1 id="一介绍">一、介绍</h1>
<p>这是一款 华为公司开源的服务器操作系统</p>
<p>操作指令雷同 centos7的操作指令</p>
<h1 id="二系统安装">二、系统安装</h1>
<h2 id="21镜像下载">2.1、镜像下载</h2>
<p><a href="https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/openeuler/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">镜像下载地址</a></p>
<h2 id="22安装步骤">2.2、安装步骤</h2>
<h3 id="221新建虚拟机"><strong>2.2.1、新建****虚拟机</strong></h3>

<p><img src="https://kcnvvdusrw1h.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=YzgwM2Q3ZGIwNWUzNTM4ZGE4NzA5ZjFkMzMyNjQ0NDZfTEhZMnlSamdHazlBMEFNcG5oeUN4cUZ1V3N1bWk4NWVfVG9rZW46R1ZVdGJIMnIxbzFrdlJ4aGVLNmNjTXJobk9jXzE3ODYxNTUxNjA6MTc4NjE1ODc2MF9WNA&amp;add_watermark=true&amp;scene_type=CCM" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>

</blockquote>

<ul>
<li>选择语言</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://kcnvvdusrw1h.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=YTM0NmI4OTJkOWYwOWNkZDZhZDVmZjQ5ZmE0MGQ5NmVfV0EwWUJtYXRoNUVzVWhiWnVxbjVmOFFEQ3VhOWVLVzhfVG9rZW46TG5ibWJyeWVSbzhQTWF4QmdtWmNxS3lsbktkXzE3ODYxNTUxNjA6MTc4NjE1ODc2MF9WNA&amp;add_watermark=true&amp;scene_type=CCM" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>

<li>设置磁盘分区， 这里自动分</li>
</ul>

<h1 id="三配置网络">三、配置网络</h1>
<ul>
<li>欧拉系统， 默认配置了动态网络， 我们直接查看ip, 远程连接，在终端操作</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://kcnvvdusrw1h.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=ZGI1YjI4YmRhYWNhOWRhZGY2MDdiOTAwOGZkNjY1N2RfcVJYbHpSaXpSV29maFd2MUVNNjlpTVpkZ1JPZWhhMGpfVG9rZW46TFBDUGJrYkJjb3lCbHN4N1lBeGN5dXd2bjVnXzE3ODYxNTUxNjA6MTc4NjE1ODc2MF9WNA&amp;add_watermark=true&amp;scene_type=CCM" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>网络配置， 直接在配置文件中修改</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-Shell"># 配置文件
[root@localhost ~]# vi /etc/sysconfig/network-scripts/ifcfg-ens33 
TYPE=Ethernet
PROXY_METHOD=none
BROWSER_ONLY=no
#BOOTPROTO=dhcp
BOOTPROTO=static
DEFROUTE=yes
IPV4_FAILURE_FATAL=no
IPV6INIT=yes
IPV6_AUTOCONF=yes
IPV6_DEFROUTE=yes
IPV6_FAILURE_FATAL=no
IPV6_ADDR_GEN_MODE=eui64
NAME=ens33
UUID=67014e6d-3425-47ab-9be5-b69a9958e508
DEVICE=ens33
ONBOOT=yes
IPADDR=192.48.75.40
NETMASK=255.255.255.0
GATEWAY=192.48.75.2
DNS=223.5.5.5

# 重启网卡
[root@localhost ~]# nmcli con reload
[root@localhost ~]# nmcli con up ens33
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>再次查看 ip</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://kcnvvdusrw1h.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=NjAzMzZmNTE3MmYyODZlMmNmNTk1ZjUzMjQ0ZGRlYzRfUWZnd0dhU0J6a2pCTmI0eHp3YW1uZDl0dXJpTWxlSzNfVG9rZW46Q0pCUGI3UlBFb2QzWU14MVRIOGNpMXYybmNlXzE3ODYxNTUxNjA6MTc4NjE1ODc2MF9WNA&amp;add_watermark=true&amp;scene_type=CCM" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="四配置本地-yum-仓库">四、配置本地 yum 仓库</h1>
<pre><code class="language-Shell"># 挂载本地磁盘
[root@localhost ~]# mount /dev/cdrom /mnt/
mount: /mnt: WARNING: source write-protected, mounted read-only.

# 永久挂载
[root@localhost ~]# echo "mount /dev/cdrom /mnt/" &gt;&gt; /root/.bashrc 

# 备份原有的 yum 配置文件
[root@localhost ~]# mv /etc/yum.repos.d/openEuler.repo /etc/yum.repos.d/openEuler.repo.bak

# 配置本地源
[root@localhost ~]# vi /etc/yum.repos.d/local.repo
[local]
name=local
baseurl=/mnt
gpgcheck=0

# 测试
[root@localhost ~]# yum clean all; yum repolist -v
……
Total packages: 2,546
</code></pre>
<h1 id="五安装基础软件">五、安装基础软件</h1>
<ul>
<li>vim</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-Shell">[root@localhost ~]# yum -y install vim
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>Bash-completion</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-Shell">[root@localhost ~]# yum -y install bash-completion
</code></pre>
